# Official ROS 1 effort_controllers source

Unmodified package sources from ros-controls/ros_controllers tag 0.22.0, commit c2348e85abf35cf33cf654a84d61db206abe9a73. The package declares BSD; all upstream copyright/license headers are preserved. LICENSE.upstream copies the complete notice from joint_position_controller.cpp. Upstream test files are omitted and our lesson builds with CATKIN_ENABLE_TESTING=OFF; production package sources, headers, plugin XML and package metadata are unchanged.

Archive URL, SHA256 and unmodified-file hashes are recorded in UPSTREAM.json. L25 copies this package into its personal vendor directory, builds it against installed Noetic dependencies, and places the real library under that local package's lib directory. pluginlib's package-relative fallback discovers it through the lesson ROS_PACKAGE_PATH. No root/sudo, online downloads or host package replacement is required. Generated files remain outside application templates.

Official sources: https://github.com/ros-controls/ros_controllers/tree/0.22.0/effort_controllers
